comment: Independent C-first ordinary shop history for shk.c fix_shop_damage/repair_damage, dopay/make_happy_shk and home_shk/mnearto. Use source-generated ordinary rooms rather than the earlier Minetown subroom first cause. First inspect dungeon level5 through actual map and detect-monsters spell to locate a real keeper; no shop is assumed. C level5 detector reports no monsters and map has no proved shop. Continue ordinary exploration to adjacent dungeon level6 and detect an actual keeper; no seed search and no shop claim from room shape. Source mklev1349 guarantees shop attempt at depth2/3 when enough rooms, unlike deeper random room families. Actual level6 is leprechaun hall, no shop. Take source-supported shallow depth3 exploration, preserving both deeper non-shop scouts. Source makemon1168 blocks all ordinary monster creation when debug_mongen is true, including shopkeeper creation. Earlier room scouts used that option and cannot prove a live shopkeeper. Toggle it off before generating fresh depth2, where mklev shallow shop attempt is source-guaranteed with enough rooms. Preserve prior missed/invalid shop setups.
